title: Beyond Consensus: Perspectivist Modeling and Evaluation of Annotator Disagreement in NLP
abstract: arXiv:2601.09065v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Annotator disagreement is widespread in NLP, particularly for subjective and ambiguous tasks such as toxicity detection and stance analysis. While early approaches treated disagreement as noise to be removed, recent work increasingly models it as a meaningful signal reflecting variation in interpretation and perspective. This survey provides a unified view of disagreement-aware NLP methods. We first present a domain-agnostic taxonomy of the sources of disagreement spanning data, task, and annotator factors. We then synthesize modeling approaches using a common framework defined by prediction targets and pooling structure, highlighting a shift from consensus learning toward explicitly modeling disagreement, and toward capturing structured relationships among annotators. We review evaluation metrics for both predictive performance and annotator behavior, and noting that most fairness evaluations remain descriptive rather than normative

translated_title: 超越共识：自然语言处理中标注者分歧的视角主义建模与评估
translated_abstract: 标注者分歧在自然语言处理（NLP）中普遍存在，尤其是在毒 toxicity 检测和立场分析等主观且模糊的任务中。早期的方法将分歧视为需要去除的噪声，而近期的研究越来越多地将其建模为一种反映解释与视角差异的有意义信号。本综述对分歧感知的NLP方法提供了一个统一的视角。我们首先提出了一个与领域无关的分歧来源分类体系，涵盖数据、任务和标注者三方面因素。随后，我们使用由预测目标和聚合结构定义的通用框架对各类建模方法进行综合梳理，突出了该领域从共识学习向显式建模分歧、以及向捕捉标注者之间结构化关系的转变。我们回顾了针对预测性能和标注者行为的评估指标，并指出大多数公平性评估仍然是描述性的而非规范性的。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了NLP中标注者分歧的来源分类、建模框架与评估指标，指出该领域正从共识学习转向显式建模分歧及标注者间的结构化关系，并发现现有公平性评估仍停留在描述性层面。
en_tdlr: This survey provides a unified view of disagreement-aware NLP methods through a domain-agnostic taxonomy of disagreement sources and a common modeling framework, highlighting the field's shift from consensus learning toward explicitly modeling disagreement and structured annotator relationships, while noting that most fairness evaluations remain descriptive rather than normative.
